context: Mei tells Ren about a place that changed.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (激しい/まわり/戻り/底/なくなっ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 久しぶりに、故郷に戻ったの。
lines.en: I returned to my hometown after a long time.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まわりは、変わっていた?
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、変化が激しくて驚いたの。
lines.en: Yeah, the change was so drastic it surprised me.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Were the old shops still there?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 好きだった店は、なくなっていたの。
lines.en: The shop I loved was gone.
lines.style: wistful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 川の底まで、見えるくらい澄んでた?
lines.en: Was it so clear you could see the riverbed?
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 川は、昔のまま底まで澄んでたよ。
lines.en: The river was clear to the bottom, just like before.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: また、まわりを一緒に歩いて戻りたいね。
lines.en: I'd like to walk the surroundings and return together again.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
